prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1098; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits and any other coverage available under the policy, including any umbrella or excess coverage, together with the identity of the adjuster assigned to this claim.

We also request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the accident. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam and surveillance footage, witness statements, repair and total-loss records, maintenance history, and all correspondence and claim notes. Any loss, alteration, or destruction of such material may result in sanctions and will be brought to the court's attention.

We look forward to your prompt response.
